import_hikvision_next.title: Import from hikvision_next
import_hikvision_next.description: Choose the hikvision_next device to set up here. Its address, credentials and notifications host settings are taken over.

alarm_server_not_set.title: {device} doesn't send events to Home Assistant
alarm_server_not_set.description:
The Notifications Host (alarm server) of **{device}** is `{address}` with the path `{path}`, so its events don't reach Home Assistant and the event sensors stay off.

In the device's web interface, set the Notifications Host to the address of this Home Assistant with the path `{expected_path}`. You can also let the integration set it: check "Set notifications host" when reconfiguring the integration.

remove_hikvision_next.title: Remove {device} from hikvision_next
remove_hikvision_next.description:
**{device}** is set up in both Hikvision Local and hikvision_next. Both poll the device, and its notifications host can point at only one of them.

1. Remove the device from hikvision_next (Settings > Devices & services > hikvision_next).
2. hikvision_next resets the device's notifications host when it is removed, so reload Hikvision Local afterwards, or set the notifications host again.

This message goes away once the hikvision_next entry is removed.
